explanation: The advisory describes a missing rate limit on password-change attempts (brute-force protection), which maps to authentication/authorization weakness CWE-307, not to the target crypto-misuse taxonomy. No cryptographic primitive, key size, hash algorithm, or password-storage misuse is demonstrated in the vulnerable or fixed code, so it does not belong to CWE-326/CRYPTO-009.
finding: [CRYPTO-009] Weak key length or weak elliptic curve. Use RSA >= 2048 bits or a NIST P-256+ curve. (CWE-326) at rdiffweb/controller/page_pref_general.py.
